entities.summary: Jahangir Bey Kazimbeyli, also known as Jahangir Bey Kazimbeyov, was an Azerbaijani military officer who had served in the Russian, Azerbaijani and Polish armies. He is known as one of the leaders of the Ganja revolt in 1920.
